## Scope

Describe the problem and the smallest implemented solution.

## Verification

List exact commands and results.

- [ ] Targeted tests pass.
- [ ] Formatting and static checks pass.
- [ ] Simulator mirrors are synchronized when the canonical HTML changed.
- [ ] New public behavior has documentation or an API contract.

## Risk

- [ ] No secrets, credentials, personal data, or restricted flight data.
- [ ] Backward compatibility and API maturity were considered.
- [ ] Safety-critical claims are supported by tests or explicitly marked experimental.
- [ ] Generated environments, build caches, and local artifacts are excluded.
